finding.text: Every review shot is Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page: the worktree server on 127.0.0.1:65118 was down when review.mjs shot it. All 8 pngs and both layout.json files are useless (`errors`: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at all four widths). This review falls back on the builder's own shots in `ai/sessions/tasks/code-the-approved-mobile-picks-as-routed/shots/` (day/nested/session/task/run-indicator at 400, day/nested/session at 1200). Re-shoot before you merge.

The task page (page 4) is titled with its folder slug. The panel bar and the breadcrumb read "sessions-and-tasks", and the real title appears only in the card head, cut to one line ("Sessions and tasks: the shape decided, the store o…"). `MobileTask` passes `title: segs.at(-1)`, and `this.retitle?.()` never fires (page 1, words 1). Evidence: task-400.png, bands 3–5.

On a 400 px phone the site chrome above the content takes 215–270 px of 900 (24–30%): header, AI title, tabs, breadcrumb and the panel title bar. On the task page the breadcrumb wraps to 3 lines, and on the session page the title appears twice (bar and h1). The owner asked for a header that can scroll away; the brief says "the title scrolls away and a compact bar slides in", but a still shot cannot show that, so it is unverified. Evidence: session-400.png and task-400.png, top bands.

Session rows say "running" twice: the amber dot, then the word "running" on the second line. The word could carry something new, such as the time or the progress. Evidence: session-400.png, Open work card.

Not shown in any shot: an idle task's start button (a play triangle), the computed "next" mark, and the Open questions card on the task page. The code has them (`MobileRun.draw`, `MobileTask.questions`). The run buttons were never pressed (builder report, "Not verified").

At 1200 the variant opens as Miller columns and the session column is narrow, so row titles wrap to 2–3 words a line ("Readmes / page: / Review"). There is also a large gap between the panel bar and the "VS Code tab" line. This is acceptable for a 400 px variant, but don't send anyone to it on a desktop. Evidence: session-1200.png, right column.
